azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "New GPD message received"
| summarize successCount = count()
| extend totalRequestsString = tostring(successCount)

AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Error processing message."
| where not (Message contains "rtp/gpd/message")
| summarize errorCount = count()
| extend totalRequestsString = tostring(errorCount)

AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "New GPD message received"
| extend messageId = tostring(Properties.message_id)
| where isnotempty(messageId)
| summarize uniqueCount = dcount(messageId)
| extend totalRequestsString = tostring(uniqueCount)

AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Error processing message."
| where not (Message contains "rtp/gpd/message")
| extend messageId = tostring(Properties.message_id)
| where isnotempty(messageId)
| summarize uniqueCount = dcount(messageId)
| extend totalRequestsString = tostring(uniqueCount)

AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Message stored in Failed Message Store"
| where Message contains "rtp/gpd/message"
| summarize dlqCount = count()
| extend totalRequestsString = tostring(dlqCount)

AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Message processed successfully" or Message startswith "Error processing message."
| extend messageId = tostring(Properties.message_id)
| where isnotempty(messageId)
| make-series
    Successi = dcountif(messageId, Message startswith "Message processed successfully") default = 0,
    Scartati = dcountif(messageId, Message startswith "Error processing message." and not (Message contains "rtp/gpd/message")) default = 0
  on TimeGenerated from bin($__timeFrom(), $sender_bin_size) to $__timeTo() step $sender_bin_size
| mv-expand TimeGenerated to typeof(datetime), Successi to typeof(long), Scartati to typeof(long)
| project TimeGenerated, Successi, Scartati
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Andamento ingestione Consumer - Successi vs Scartati nel tempo

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-consumer'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Payload:"
| extend
    msg_id          = extract(@"id=(\d+)", 1, Message),
    operation       = extract(@"operation=(\w+)", 1, Message),
    status          = extract(@"status=([A-Z_]+)", 1, Message),
    ec_tax_code     = extract(@"ec_tax_code=([^,\]]+)", 1, Message),
    debtor_tax_code = extract(@"debtor_tax_code=([^,\]]+)", 1, Message),
    iuv             = extract(@"iuv=([^,\]]+)", 1, Message)
| where isnotempty(msg_id)
| summarize
    ["Consegne EVH"]     = count(),
    ["Prima consegna"]   = min(TimeGenerated),
    ["Ultima consegna"]  = max(TimeGenerated),
    ["Operazione"]       = take_any(operation),
    ["Status GPD"]       = take_any(status),
    ["EC Tax Code"]      = take_any(ec_tax_code),
    ["Debtor Tax Code"]  = take_any(debtor_tax_code),
    ["IUV"]              = take_any(iuv)
    by msg_id
| where ["Consegne EVH"] > 1
| extend ["Debtor Tax Code"] = strcat(
    substring(["Debtor Tax Code"], 0, 3),
    substring("***********", 0, strlen(["Debtor Tax Code"]) - 5),
    substring(["Debtor Tax Code"], strlen(["Debtor Tax Code"]) - 2, 2)
)
| project
    ["Message ID"]      = msg_id,
    ["Consegne EVH"]    = ["Consegne EVH"],
    ["Prima consegna"]  = ["Prima consegna"],
    ["Ultima consegna"] = ["Ultima consegna"],
    ["Operazione"]      = ["Operazione"],
    ["Status GPD"]      = ["Status GPD"],
    ["EC Tax Code"]     = ["EC Tax Code"],
    ["Debtor Tax Code"] = ["Debtor Tax Code"],
    ["IUV"]             = ["IUV"]
| sort by ["Consegne EVH"] desc
| limit 100

| extend
    msg_id = extract(@"id=(\d+)", 1, Message),

| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)

| sort by ["Operazione"] asc

let statusLegend = datatable(statusCode: string, description: string)
[
    "200", "OK - Successo",
    "400", "Bad Request",
    "401", "Unauthorized",
    "403", "Forbidden",
    "409", "Conflict - Idempotenza",
    "422", "Unprocessable - Business error",
    "499", "Client closed",
    "503", "Service Unavailable",
    "504", "Gateway Timeout"
];
AzureDiagnostics
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where requestUri_s contains 'rtp/gpd/message'
| where httpMethod_s == "POST"
| summarize count() by statusCode = tostring(toint(httpStatus_d))
| join kind=leftouter statusLegend on statusCode
| project label = strcat(statusCode, " - ", coalesce(description, "Altro")), count_
| evaluate pivot(label, sum(count_))

panels.title: ✅ Invii con successo per Service Provider del debitore

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let fallimenti = AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-sender'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SeverityLevel == 3
| where Message startswith "Error sending Rtp to be sent:"
| extend _err = trim(" ", replace_string(Message, "Error sending Rtp to be sent:", ""))
| extend Categoria = case(
    _err contains "payer is not activated",                "⚠️ Payer non attivato",
    _err contains "rejected" or _err contains "Reject",   "❌ Rejection SEPA",
    _err contains "imeout",                               "❌ Timeout",
    _err contains "Connection" or _err contains "refused", "❌ Errore di rete",
    _err contains "MongoWrite" or _err contains "Mongo"
        or _err contains "TooManyRequest",                "❌ Errore DB Mongo",
    _err contains "PayeeNotFound"
        or _err contains "ServiceProviderNotFound",       "❌ Payee/SP non trovato",
    _err contains "InvalidTransition"
        or _err contains "InvalidStatus",                 "❌ Transizione invalida",
    "❌ Altro / non classificato"
)
| summarize Conteggio = count() by Categoria;
let successi = AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-sender'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SeverityLevel == 1
| where Message startswith "Rtp sent successfully with id:"
| summarize Conteggio = count()
| extend Categoria = "✅ Successo";
let dettaglio = union fallimenti, successi;
dettaglio
| project Categoria, Conteggio
| evaluate pivot(Categoria, sum(Conteggio))

panels.title: Monitoraggio di invii falliti o non processati per tipologia
panels.description: Successi e fallimenti per tipologia di errore.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let ops = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-sender"
| where Message startswith "Operation: "
| extend Operation = extract(@"Operation: (\w+)", 1, Message)
| summarize Operation = any(Operation) by OperationId;
let successes = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-sender"
| where Message == "Successfully processed message."
| summarize TimeGenerated = min(TimeGenerated) by OperationId;
let errors = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-sender"
| where Message startswith "Error processing message."
| where Message !contains "PayerNotActivatedException"
| where Message !contains "InvalidTransitionException"
| where Message !contains "RtpNotFoundException"
| summarize TimeGenerated = min(TimeGenerated) by OperationId;
union
    (successes | join kind=inner ops on OperationId | extend Series = strcat("✅ ", Operation)),
    (errors    | join kind=inner ops on OperationId | extend Series = strcat("❌ ", Operation))
| make-series Count = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated from bin($__timeFrom(), $sender_bin_size) to $__timeTo() step $sender_bin_size by Series
| mv-expand TimeGenerated to typeof(datetime), Count to typeof(long)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

panels.title: Invii RTP nel tempo (Successi vs Fallimenti) nel tempo

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let saveLog =
    AppTraces
    | where AppRoleName == "rtp-sender"
    | where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
    | where Message startswith "Rtp to be sent saved with id:"
    | extend
        rtp_id           = extract(@"Rtp to be sent saved with id:\s*([^\s.]+)", 1, Message),
        service_provider = extract(@"service_provider:\s*(\S+)", 1, Message)
    | project OperationId, rtp_id, service_provider;
AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-sender"
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SeverityLevel == 1
| where Message startswith "Rtp sent successfully with id:"
| extend rtp_operation_id = extract(@"Rtp sent successfully with id:\s*([^\s.]+)", 1, Message)
| join kind=inner saveLog on OperationId
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    service_provider,
    rtp_operation_id,
    correlation_id = Properties["correlation_id"],
    resource_id    = Properties["resource_id"]
| top 100 by TimeGenerated desc

let DebtorInfo = AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-sender'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where Message startswith "Rtp to be sent saved with id:"
| extend resource_id = tostring(Properties["resource_id"])
| parse Message with "Rtp to be sent saved with id: " * ". service_provider: " debtor_service_provider
| project resource_id, debtor_service_provider;
AppTraces
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-sender'
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where SeverityLevel == 3
| where Message startswith "Error sending Rtp to be sent:"
| where Message !contains "payer is not activated"
| extend errorMessage = trim(" ", replace_string(Message, "Error sending Rtp to be sent:", ""))
| extend Categoria = case(
    errorMessage contains "TooMany" or errorMessage contains "429",          "Troppe richieste MongoDB",
    errorMessage contains "DuplicateKey" or errorMessage contains "dup key", "Chiave duplicata MongoDB",
    errorMessage contains "MongoWrite" or errorMessage contains "Mongo",     "Errore MongoDB",
    errorMessage contains "imeout",                                          "Timeout",
    errorMessage contains "Connection" or errorMessage contains "refused",   "Errore di rete",
    errorMessage contains "rejected" or errorMessage contains "Reject",      "Rejection SEPA",
    "Altro")
| extend resource_id = tostring(Properties["resource_id"]),
